### Non-obvious Logic

1. **Email thread is all outbound** — All three visible emails are from Matt Ryan TO Laurie McAdam. FUB renders both inbound and outbound in the same thread. Direction indicated by the "→" or "←" arrow in the sender/recipient line.

2. **Sender/recipient dropdown (▾):** Clicking expands to show full email headers (TO, CC, BCC, full email addresses). This is a FUB pattern to keep the thread view clean while allowing inspection of header details.

3. **Email composer is always-present at top** — Unlike a traditional email client where you open a compose window, FUB keeps a persistent compose strip at the top of the email thread, pre-addressed to the contact. Clicking "Send Email" fires immediately; the clock icon schedules for later.

4. **Automation status "Running" with ⏸ pause** — The pause pauses the automation *for this person only*, not globally. The automation plan continues to enroll other people. This is per-person enrollment control.

5. **Email signature card (inline rich card):** The "Oregon Initial Agency Disclosure Pamphlet" link at the bottom of the signature is a legal compliance requirement under ORS 696.820 (Oregon). This must be included at first contact. FUB renders this as part of the email body HTML, not a separate attachment.

6. **"Scroll to top" button appears on scroll** — Only visible when the user has scrolled down in the thread. It returns to the newest/top email. Suggests the thread renders oldest-to-newest from bottom-to-top OR newest-to-oldest from top-to-bottom (this screen shows newest at top by position, oldest at bottom — so "scroll to top" goes to newest).

7. **Files section supports drag-and-drop** — The empty state text "drag some here" indicates the section has a dragover event listener to accept file drops directly without clicking the "+" button.

8. **Keyboard navigation between leads** — The "Press → to view next lead or ← to view previous lead" hint indicates FUB maintains a sorted list context (whatever list/smart list the user came from) and arrow keys cycle through that list's records without returning to the list view. This requires the backend to maintain a "current session list" cursor or pass list order via URL params.

9. **Person ID 27022 in URL** — FUB uses sequential integer IDs for people records at `/2/people/view/{id}`. The `/2/` segment appears to be a workspace/account namespace.

10. **Getting Started bar (2/7)** — This is an account-level onboarding widget shown globally until all 7 steps are completed. It is not person-specific.

11. **Automation "(1)" badge** — The count in parentheses on the Automations section header reflects active enrollments for THIS person only, not total automations in the account.

12. **Email attachment display** — Attachments shown inline in the email body after the signature, as a clickable link with filename and size. Format: `📎 [filename] ([size])`. Clicking downloads or previews the file.
